set -eu
umask 077
cw_env_dir='/home/codewire/.codewire'
/bin/mkdir -p -- "$cw_env_dir"
cw_env_file=$(/usr/bin/mktemp "$cw_env_dir/.environment.XXXXXXXX")
trap '/bin/rm -f -- "$cw_env_file"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
/bin/cat > "$cw_env_file" <<'CW_ENVIRONMENT_JSON_0'
{
  "ALPHA_KEY": "plain-value",
  "CONNECT_URL": "postgres://u:p@h:5432/db?sslmode=disable",
  "ZETA_TOKEN": "it's quoted"
}
CW_ENVIRONMENT_JSON_0
/bin/chmod 0600 -- "$cw_env_file"
/bin/mv -fT -- "$cw_env_file" "$cw_env_dir/environment.json"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
